entries: Ah... You are not bored...

Argh!
So frustrating! Whywhywhy?{VAR BE01}

You're awesome!
I don't mind giving you a little credit!

How are you, Trainer?
I won't lose today.{VAR BE01}

time on my hands.{VAR BE01}

I will have a battle with you.

You are as strong as usual.
But I wonder what will happen next time.{VAR BE01}

None of the Riches is a match for you...{VAR BE01}
I admire your strength!
Oh, it's quite lively for some reason.{VAR BE01}

Hoho! Do you have confidence
in winning against me?{VAR BE01}

Ho, ho. You are genuinely strong!
You look dependable!{VAR BE01}

Children of today are very strong in
Pokémon battles.{VAR BE01}

can become Trainers like you?

Hoho!
Pokémon battles bring back memories.{VAR BE01}

I am so excited, my blood is boiling!

is not bad from time to time!
